purpose: Small outcome-blind paired pilot to estimate terminal reach and expose major failure modes before committing compute and tokens to a larger Spark batch.

case_free_provider_diagnostics.interpretation: The provider completed with finish_reason=stop but the response violated the exact candidate output contract.
A read-only diagnostic rerun passed before the formal admission probe.

supersedes_for_execution.reason: Post-freeze repository-free counterexamples required Algorithm v17 and Harness v32, and an eight-pair calibration pilot is inserted before any bulk qualification. Q12 selected zero cases and remains a historical preregistration.

execution_revision_rule: Use a clean descendant containing the v17/v32 freeze, this preregistration, and later frozen pilot selection or schedule metadata; every bound hash below must match.

checks: Algorithm v17 and Harness v32 hashes match this preregistration
full regression returns 413 passed, 1 skipped, and 69 subtests passed
real Docker integration passes with ENVSOLVE_DOCKER_TEST=1
EnvBench revision is clean and matches the frozen evaluator revision
a case-free OpenRouter probe succeeds with deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro
host_admission_gate.failure_policy: Do not select pilot cases; repair and issue a superseding preregistration if any frozen file changes.

matched_primitive_limits.matching_basis: primitive limits; USD is operational metadata only

pilot_outcomes: internal pass and natural Boolean Official reach by method
paired descriptive Official outcome without inferential effect estimate
candidate command failure and validation rejection decomposition
repeated failed path and negative-operation guard utilization
model, token, environment, command, and wall-clock use

predeclared_decision_gate.proceed_to_bulk: At least two scientifically eligible EnvSolve runs naturally reach Boolean Official outcomes, no shared boundary invariant fails, and EnvSolve has no unexplained paired regression against the free-form baseline.
predeclared_decision_gate.halt_zero_terminal_reach: If fewer than two EnvSolve runs naturally reach Boolean Official outcomes, do not start the bulk Spark batch; perform consumed-trajectory failure analysis first.
predeclared_decision_gate.halt_paired_regression: If the baseline reaches or passes Official while EnvSolve on the same case does not, pause bulk execution for paired error analysis before any algorithm decision.
predeclared_decision_gate.encouraging_not_confirmatory: EnvSolve-only success is a development signal, not an effectiveness or leaderboard claim.
predeclared_decision_gate.algorithm_change_after_pilot: Consume all eight identities, refreeze, and preregister a new bulk batch from the 133 remaining identities.

execution_rule.complete_batch: Run all eight frozen pairs unless a shared boundary invariant fails or the operator interrupts execution.
execution_rule.zero_information_pre_episode_failure: One audited same-identity retry only when model, candidate, environment, command, evaluator, and method information are all zero.
execution_rule.partial_process_interruption: Mark the position scientifically ineligible without overwrite or rerun.
execution_rule.terminal_evaluator_infrastructure_failur: One evaluator-only retry of the identical script with zero new model calls.
execution_rule.other_infrastructure_failure: Record Unknown and censor the pair without replacement.
